Mean log real MPCE robustness outcome; sample-support thresholds apply but no relative-SE cutoff is imposed because relative SE of a log-level mean is not a consumption CV.
Design-based person-weighted median real MPCE; survey quantile uncertainty is retained and support/precision flags never delete estimates.

Design-based mean real MPCE among the bottom 40 percent of represented persons; estimated only where district support is adequate: the pre-treatment 2004-05 round and the two modern HCES replication rounds. NSS-64 point estimates remain available through core welfare outcomes, but bottom-40 is not registered because too few districts pass the predeclared lower-tail support gate.
